step1_analysis.description: A low-voltage RF front-end amplifier using a folded cascode topology. The NMOS acts as a transconductor and the PMOS acts as a common-gate cascode stage, allowing operation from a low supply voltage by avoiding stacking transistors between VDD and GND.

paper_reference.title: Low-Voltage 1.9-GHz Front-End Receiver in 0.5-m CMOS Technology

voltage_gain.description: Voltage gain at the operating frequency of 1.9 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: NMOS gm1 = 1.3 mA/V (at VGS=0.9V, W/L=10). Assuming an LC tank with 10 kOhm parallel resistance, the effective transconductance Gm is ~1.18 mA/V. Gain = Gm * Rout = 1.18m * 10k = 11.8 V/V = 21.4 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the chosen LC tank parallel resistance. With a 10k resistor, gain is around 21 dB, which is close to the 15 dB reported in the paper.

center_frequency.description: Operating frequency of the LNA, set by the output LC tank.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)) = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(5nH * 1.4pF)) = 1.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the passive LC tank components added in the testbench to match the paper's target frequency.

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the 400uA folding current source used to bias the NMOS and PMOS in the testbench.

output_power.description: Output power delivered to a 50-ohm equivalent load for a 100mV peak input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vout_peak ~ 1.0V (compressed due to voltage headroom). Pout = (1.0^2 / 2) / 50 = 10 mW = 10 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the transient voltage swing across the tank, referenced to 50 ohms to match standard RF metrics.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the Folded Cascode LNA, measuring DC power, AC gain at 1.9 GHz, and transient output power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Folded Cascode LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xms=5u L_xms=0.5u
.param W_xmg=5u L_xmg=0.5u

XMS N0 VIN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xms} w={W_xms}
XMG VOUT BIAS N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmg} w={W_xmg}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1.9G)
VBIAS BIAS 0 DC 0.2

* Folding current source to supply both NMOS and PMOS
IFOLD VDD N0 DC 400u

* Output LC Tank tuned to 1.9 GHz
LLOAD VOUT 0 5n
CLOAD VOUT 0 1.4p
RTANK VOUT 0 10k

.control
op
let p_dc = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print p_dc

ac dec 100 100MEG 10G
let gain_db = vdb(vout)
meas ac gain_at_1g9 find gain_db at=1.9G
meas ac max_gain max gain_db

tran 10p 20n
meas tran vout_max max v(vout) from=10n to=20n
meas tran vout_min min v(vout) from=10n to=20n
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
let vout_amp = vout_pp / 2
* Calculate equivalent power in dBm referenced to 50 ohms
let p_out_dbm = 10 * log10( (vout_amp * vout_amp) / 100 * 1000 )
print p_out_dbm
quit
.endc
